alex: quick heads-up — spun up q4a-compact (int4) on staging for long-context bringup. after ~66k tokens the model drops referent coherence. repro: ./play --model q4a-compact --seq 90000 --prompts tests/long/66k.txt
sam: can you paste the KV rotation logs? specifically look for rotate_to_seg and any write_len=0 entries.
alex: minimal tail logs:
[KV] rotate_to_seg=1 abs_idx=65536 write_len=0
[KV] consumer_read abs_idx=65537 buf_sum=0
[ATTN] head0 norm abs_idx=65536 0.0006
[METRIC] coherence 0.89 -> 0.60 at 65542
sam: that looks like the transport cleared the buffer on rotate before consumer finished. try rerun with runtime flag disable_zero_clear=true and see.
tess: also dump rope_phase around the fence (abs_idx 65530..65540) to rule out phase discontinuity. small script: for i in range(65530,65541): print(i, compute_rope_phase(i))
alex: ran both: phase values continuous (tiny float deltas). with disable_zero_clear=true the coherence drop no longer reproduces in 3/3 runs. suggests zeroing is culprit.
sam: mitigation plan: 1) lightweight runtime guard — if kv_checksum(abs_idx) < eps request_replay(abs_idx-64, abs_idx+64); 2) transport PR to change rotate to write a tombstone marker instead of memset until ack.
tess: i'll run an fp32 baseline and coref F1 sweep to quantify impact of the guard.
deploy-bot: canary deploy queued: q4a-compact kv-guard opt-in 5% (job id: canary-177555).
alex: branch and test set: github.com/redwood-inference/bringup/kv-tombstone and tests/long/66k.txt — will follow up with aggregated numbers. :thumbsup:
